1.title: How Trump Is Wielding Power to Stifle Speech
1.summary: President Trump has harnessed agencies across the government to curtail press freedoms, a sweeping campaign that free speech advocates say will have lasting effects.

2.title: Teen boy rescued after days adrift in Alaskan waters
2.summary: The 15-year-old boy was rescued while the other two passengers from the capsized fishing vessel, his brother and cousin, died.

3.title: Republican Groups Rush to Paxton’s Aid in Texas After Staying on Sidelines
3.summary: An organization allied with Senate G.O.P. leaders has booked more than $51 million in ads. Now, Ken Paxton has a financial edge after months of being outspent by his Democratic rival.

4.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
4.summary: Amodei's call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.

5.title: Uganda's King Oyo buried amid calls for unity over his successor
5.summary: A TV news presenter has been named as the traditional kingdom of Tooro's new monarch but the late king's family claim he chose an heir.

6.title: Saudi Arabia’s Oil ‘Lifeline’ Was Attacked. Here’s What to Know.
6.summary: A drone attack from Iraq forced Saudi Arabia to close its East-West pipeline, the kingdom said, threatening a key workaround to Iran’s Persian Gulf blockade.
